title: England's most Euros appearances
brief: Name the ten players with the most appearances for England at European Championship finals since Euro 96, including games as a substitute.

notes.Steven Gerrard: Steven Gerrard is just outside with 9 games.
notes.Luke Shaw: Luke Shaw is just outside with 9 games.

sources: https://compstats.uefa.com/v1/player-ranking?competitionId=3&phase=TOURNAMENT&stats=matches_appearance,goals&seasonYear=<year> (UEFA's own player stats, one call per tournament 1996 to 2024)
https://www.transfermarkt.com/england/leistungsdaten/verein/3299/plus/1?reldata=EURO%26<season> (England squad stats for each Euros, 1996 to 2024)
checks: UEFA's and Transfermarkt's per-tournament appearances agree for every England player at every Euros from 1996 to 2024 (no differences). The 10-game pool for 9th and 10th: Rooney, Sterling, Bellingham and Foden.
